tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get the connected Karaoke Maker account, existing balance and supported Quick features.

tools.name: prepare_karaoke
tools.description: Import the user's selected MP3 and prepare a free Quick draft with a price quote. No processing starts. Use only a file the user selected for this task.

tools.name: create_local_upload
tools.description: Authorize a short-lived upload of the user's selected local MP3. Supply its filename, exact byte size and SHA256, then stream that file with the returned PUT URL and purpose-bound headers. No OAuth credentials are needed or exposed. The PUT creates a free Quick draft; read it with get_karaoke, then

tools.name: start_karaoke
tools.description: Start the quoted Quick karaoke after the user confirms its price and visual preferences. Reserves the existing account balance and launches background processing. Use the current quote and revision; reuse the same key after a lost response.

tools.name: get_karaoke
tools.description: Read a Quick project's authoritative status, progress, allowed actions and current MP4 links. Use to resume or check processing without starting new work.

tools.name: show_karaoke
tools.description: Show the compact Quick card. For an unstarted project, pass the user's concise visual_preferences to prefill its confirmation card; an empty string explicitly lets Quick choose. This presentation draft is not saved until start. Omit preferences to show existing work; started designs cannot be change

tools.name: refresh_karaoke_quote
tools.description: Refresh an expired, unstarted project's quote and status. Show the returned terms before starting. Does not reserve funds or launch processing.

tools.name: list_karaokes
tools.description: List the connected account's Quick projects to find work to continue in this chat.

tools.name: retry_karaoke
tools.description: Retry a failed or stale Quick stage only when can_retry is true. Keeps the existing project, saved visual preferences and completed stages. This does not request a new creative design.

tools.name: cancel_karaoke
tools.description: Cancel this Quick workflow when can_cancel is true. Stops successor stages; completed preparation charges follow the existing service rules.

tools.name: open_in_studio
tools.description: Hand this project from automatic Quick processing to the full Studio editor when the user requests manual correction. Stops Quick automation; this is an intentional change, not just a preview link.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_local_upload" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Authorize a short-lived upload of the user's selected local MP3. Supply its filename, exact byte size and SHA256, then stream that file with the returned PUT UR…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_local_upload, list_karaokes · Private data: prepare_karaoke, create_local_upload · Public sink: create_local_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_local_upload, list_karaokes · Private data: prepare_karaoke, create_local_upload · Public sink: create_local_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
